experiment: E100 Amendment 1: does the sum of single-part reverts sort fed from written on seeds E100 never read? For E58's four open-pair maps at seeds 3-7, read the gain G and the 28 single-part reverts; read fed / written / between from their sum
found_post_hoc: The rule and both bars were found after reading E100's table (jobs 52839, 52873) on seeds 0-2 of every task; they are not a result there. This amendment tests them on 20 states E100 never read (open_pair_instruments seeds 3-7)
limit: a new circuit built from old parts still reads as reuse

definitions.part: one head's output or one block's MLP output; 24 heads and 4 MLPs, which partition every entry of dW (E100's predictions.json)
definitions.unit: lo: log-odds of the target against every other token at the read position (identity.log_odds), in nats
definitions.G: the state's mean over the site's reads minus W0's over the same reads, unit lo
definitions.own: the state with one part's own update reverted (a head: its rows of q, k, v and columns of o; an MLP: c_fc and down_proj); share = (state - reverted) / G (locator.own, the same read as E100's own in locator.split)
definitions.reverts_sum: the sum of own over the 28 single parts (fed_rules.reverts_sum, as E100's table): 1 when the update is additive over parts; low when the gain needs many parts changed together, high when it comes apart piece by piece

settings.states: experiments/open_pair_instruments/results/large/{copy,cipher,rank1,elicit}_s{3..7}.pt, each checked against the sha256 in experiments/open_pair_instruments/results/seeds.json .states[<map>_s<seed>].ft.sha256; E58's recipe as seeds 0-2 (open_pair_instruments/seeds.py)
settings.sites: the site E100 read each task's seeds 0-2 on (experiments/locator_table/sites.py TASKS[task].site: kv_copy24, kv_cipher24, kv_rank1, kv_elicit, E90's kv_site held-out windows of the same windows files the maps were trained from)
settings.stage0_state: T5 copy seed 0 (E62 copy) on site e62_copy, as E100 stage 1

thresholds.fed_bar_source: the largest copy row of E100's table, seeds 0-2 (T13 copy-24 seed 0, 0.3951), rounded as the plan files it
thresholds.written_bar_source: the smallest row new by construction in E100's table, seeds 0-2 (T5 lookup seed 1, 0.6217), rounded as the plan files it
thresholds.min_gain_source: the plan's edge cases: a gain at or below 1 nat reads 'no gain'
thresholds.stage0_ref_source: E100's saved sum for T5 copy s0 (fed_or_written/results/table.json, stage1.json); the plan quotes it as 0.262

rule.reading: per state: G <= min_gain -> 'no gain'; reverts_sum not finite -> 'unreadable: sum not finite'; reverts_sum <= fed_bar -> 'fed'; reverts_sum >= written_bar -> 'written'; else 'between'. A sum past 1 counts (reads written); a negative sum reads fed; a sum exactly at a bar takes the bar's side. Code: fed_rules.sum_reading
rule.pass: copy-24 seeds reading fed plus cipher seeds reading written, at least 9 of the 10 (fed_rules.sum_pass). Fail: fewer; the sum is then reported as a description of seeds 0-2 only
rule.stage0: the re-read of T5 copy s0's sum must be within stage0_tol of stage0_ref, or the job stops (exit 1) before any fresh state is read
rule.edge_cases_tested: tests/test_fed_rules.py: G exactly 1 nat and under -> no gain; sums exactly 0.40 and 0.62 -> fed and written; sum 1.3 -> written; negative sum -> fed; nan sum -> unreadable; one miss passes, two fail; empty pools fail
rule.do_nothing: W0 as the state: G = 0 and every own share nan, so it reads 'no gain' and cannot count toward the pass (tests/test_fed_rules.py::test_sum_do_nothing_state)

expected.stage0: reverts_sum 0.26277 within 1e-3 (deterministic fp32 path, same code, same site; expected to agree to ~1e-6)
expected.leans_source: the plan: copy fed on all five seeds; cipher written on all five; rank-1 written (as seeds 0-2, 0.72); half-known (elicit) between (seeds 0-2, 0.47-0.51)

outputs: results/amend1.json (stage0, states with own per part, tasks, outcome); results/table_amend1.json (E100's rows with reverts_sum_reading, then the 20 fresh rows); E100's table.json unchanged
